versions.changelog:
Initial release: Foundation WeChat long-form writing skill with topic-to-draft, rewrite, and polish features.

- Generate WeChat article drafts from topic cards or subject descriptions, saving results to draft.md.
- Supports rewrite and polish modes, following integrated writing constraints (target_reader, tone, writing_style).
- Enforces configuration: requires non-empty article_category, target_reader, default_author in .aws-article/config.yaml before drafting.
- Flexible model usage: supports third-party LLM endpoints via config; auto-fallback to current conversation model if not configured.
- Robust error handling and self-check: manages API failures, guides user through config/key input, and ensures correct directory naming.
